records.source: A stranger?... Hello.#$e#Don't mind me. I just live out here alone.
records.translation: Isang estranghero?... Kumusta.#$e#Huwag mo akong alalahanin. Namumuhay lang akong mag-isa rito sa labas.

records.source: This means a lot to me, @. I'll save it for a quiet day in the tent. Thank you!
records.translation: Napakahalaga nito sa akin, @. Itatabi ko ito para sa isang tahimik na araw sa tolda. Salamat!

records.source: I don't usually read books... But this one is right up my 'alley'... Thank you!$h
records.translation: Hindi ako karaniwang nagbabasa ng mga aklat... Pero bagay na bagay ito sa aking “eskinita”... Salamat!$h

records.source: That's a good find! I'm always happy when eating wild food. Thank you.
records.translation: Maganda ang nahanap mo! Palagi akong masaya kapag kumakain ng ligaw na pagkain. Salamat.

records.source: I thought about tying the knot, once. But now, I'm happily married to the wind rustling in the leaves, and the frogs croaking under the silver moon.
records.translation: Minsan ay naisip kong magpakasal. Pero ngayon, maligaya akong kasal sa hanging kumakaluskos sa mga dahon at sa mga palakang kumokokak sa ilalim ng pilak na buwan.

records.source: All these strange trees will be gone tomorrow... it's one of the mysteries of nature.
records.translation: Mawawala bukas ang lahat ng kakaibang punong ito... isa iyon sa mga hiwaga ng kalikasan.

records.source: How did the moss harvest go? Hehe... My bed is a lot softer now.
records.translation: Kumusta ang pag-ani ng lumot? Hehe... Mas malambot na ngayon ang higaan ko.

records.source: I've already gathered enough moss for the entire year. How about you?
records.translation: Nakapangalap na ako ng sapat na lumot para sa buong taon. Ikaw ba?

records.source: Let me see... it looks perfect. You're a good student, @.$h
records.translation: Tingnan ko... Mukhang perpekto. Mahusay kang mag-aaral, @.$h

records.source: No, thank you. I have no desire for money... In fact, I think it's cursed. [166]
records.translation: Hindi na, salamat. Wala akong hangaring magkaroon ng pera... Sa katunayan, sa tingin ko ay isinumpa iyon. [166]

records.source: Ah, that looks fresh. I'll be eating good tonight!$h
records.translation: Ah, mukhang sariwa iyan. Masarap ang kakainin ko ngayong gabi!$h

records.source: What do you have there? Looks like it would make good bait.$h
records.translation: Ano iyan? Mukhang magiging magandang pain.$h

records.source: My old friend, the glimmering boulder, has moved on. It may not seem like an important event, but to me it's a big change.#$b#I'm happy for the old rock to see more of the world, though.$h
records.translation: Lumipat na ang matagal kong kaibigang Kumikinang na Malaking Bato. Maaaring hindi iyon mukhang mahalagang pangyayari, pero malaking pagbabago iyon para sa akin.#$b#Gayunman, natutuwa akong makakakita pa ng mundo ang matandang bato.$h

records.source: Very few people have gone as deep into the mines as you have.
records.translation: Iilang tao lamang ang nakarating nang kasinlalim mo sa mga Minahan.

records.source: The water here comes from glaciers high up in the mountains.#$e#I traveled to the source once, just to pay my respects to the water.
records.translation: Nagmumula ang tubig dito sa mga glacier sa itaas ng mga bundok.#$e#Minsan ay naglakbay ako patungo sa pinagmulan upang magbigay-galang sa tubig.

records.source: Movie theater? Hmm... for me, the slow procession of nature is all the drama I need.
records.translation: Sinehan? Hmm... Para sa akin, sapat nang drama ang mabagal na pag-usad ng kalikasan.

records.source: Oh... me? I usually wouldn't, but... okay. It's nice of you to think about me.#$b#I'll head over there in a little while.
records.translation: Ah... ako? Karaniwan ay hindi ako sasama, pero... sige. Mabait mong naisip ako.#$b#Pupunta ako roon maya-maya.

records.source: Find anything good?$h
records.translation: May maganda kang nahanap?$h

records.source: The crisp air of the wilderness is all I care to know.#$e#I live out here by choice.
records.translation: Tanging ang sariwang hangin ng ilang ang mahalaga sa akin.#$e#Pinili kong mamuhay rito sa labas.

records.source: ...Have you come to ridicule me?#$e#I'm just minding my own business.
records.translation: ...Pumunta ka ba upang kutyain ako?#$e#Tahimik lang akong namumuhay.

records.source: I don't know you well enough to trust you. Sorry.
records.translation: Hindi pa sapat ang pagkakakilala ko sa iyo upang magtiwala sa iyo. Paumanhin.

records.source: ...Hmm? Do you want something from me?
records.translation: ...Hmm? May gusto ka ba sa akin?

records.source: Please don't destroy my tent.#$e#It's happened before.$s
records.translation: Pakiusap, huwag mong sirain ang tolda ko.#$e#Nangyari na iyon noon.$s

records.source: I'm happy by myself, you know.#$e#I don't need new friends.
records.translation: Masaya ako nang mag-isa, alam mo.#$e#Hindi ko kailangan ng mga bagong kaibigan.

records.source: It would be nice if the townspeople could accept me for who I am.$s#$b#I like living out here in the open air. That's what they don't understand.
records.translation: Sana matanggap ako ng mga tagabayan kung sino ako.$s#$b#Gusto kong mamuhay rito sa bukas na hangin. Iyon ang hindi nila nauunawaan.

records.source: You can learn to survive in the wild. I have.#$e#I think we all have a hidden urge to return to nature. It's just a little scary to make the leap.
records.translation: Matututo kang mabuhay sa ilang. Natutuhan ko iyon.#$e#Sa tingin ko, nakatago sa ating lahat ang hangaring bumalik sa kalikasan. Medyo nakatatakot lang gawin ang unang hakbang.

records.source: I spend a lot of time thinking.#$e#If you can fully understand the reasons behind your thoughts, you'll have reached a new level of being.
records.translation: Marami akong oras na ginugugol sa pag-iisip.#$e#Kung lubos mong mauunawaan ang mga dahilan sa likod ng mga iniisip mo, mararating mo ang bagong antas ng pagkatao.

records.source: I have to be wary of strangers. Most people don't like a 'wild man'.
records.translation: Kailangan kong mag-ingat sa mga estranghero. Ayaw ng karamihan sa isang “taong-gubat”.

records.source: The people here seem nice, but they avoid me.#$e#People are afraid of the unknown.$u
records.translation: Mukhang mababait ang mga tao rito, pero iniiwasan nila ako.#$e#Natatakot ang mga tao sa hindi nalalaman.$u

records.source: You can learn a lot from trees.#$b#Spend time with them and they might tell you their secrets.#$e#Go in peace, young one.
records.translation: Marami kang matututuhan mula sa mga puno.#$b#Magpalipas ka ng oras kasama ang mga iyon at baka sabihin nila sa iyo ang kanilang mga lihim.#$e#Humayo ka nang payapa, bata.

records.source: I have everything I need to survive, and more. Nature plays a wonderful tune if you can only learn to listen.
records.translation: Nasa akin na ang lahat ng kailangan ko upang mabuhay, at higit pa. Tumutugtog ang kalikasan ng kahanga-hangang himig kung matututo ka lamang makinig.

records.source: #$1 linusVandal#Someone was throwing rocks at my tent last night... I just had to wait it out.$s$k#$e#I don't like to stay in one place for too long. There's just too much to experience in the world.
records.translation: #$1 linusVandal#May naghagis ng mga bato sa tolda ko kagabi... Kinailangan ko lang hintaying matapos iyon.$s$k#$e#Ayaw kong manatili nang napakatagal sa iisang lugar. Napakarami lang talagang mararanasan sa mundo.

records.source: During all these years I've discovered a few secrets about life.#$e#You'll have to find out for yourself.
records.translation: Sa lahat ng nagdaang taon, may natuklasan akong ilang lihim tungkol sa buhay.#$e#Kailangan mong tuklasin ang mga iyon nang mag-isa.

records.source: #$1 LinusHeron#I saw a heron wading gracefully through the morning mist. Such are the treasures of a quiet life.$k#$e#It's so easy to get caught up in the noise of modern life. Your best years will pass you by in a formless blur. That's why you've got to learn to slow down.
records.translation: #$1 LinusHeron#May nakita akong tagak na marikit na lumulusong sa hamog ng umaga. Ganiyan ang mga kayamanan ng tahimik na buhay.$k#$e#Napakadaling malunod sa ingay ng makabagong buhay. Lilipas ang pinakamagagandang taon mo sa isang malabong daloy. Kaya kailangan mong matutong magdahan-dahan.

records.source: How have you been, my young friend?
records.translation: Kumusta ka, batang kaibigan?

records.source: Ah... summer. The warm sun heats up the cans for me.#$b#Then at night I've got a warm meal to look forward to.
records.translation: Ah... tag-init. Pinaiinit ng araw ang mga lata ko.#$b#Pagdating ng gabi, may mainit akong pagkaing aasahan.

records.source: I have my own reasons for living alone like this.#$e#Some things are best left unsaid...#$e#I should do some foraging.
records.translation: May sarili akong mga dahilan sa pamumuhay nang mag-isa sa ganitong paraan.#$e#May ilang bagay na mas mabuting hindi sabihin...#$e#Dapat akong mangalap.

records.source: Whenever you catch a fish, take a moment to thank it for its sacrifice.#$b#Even if you don't believe in the spirit of the fish, it's a good mental exercise. We need to be aware of our effect on the environment.
records.translation: Sa tuwing manghuhuli ka ng isda, maglaan ng sandali upang pasalamatan ito sa sakripisyo nito.#$b#Kahit hindi ka naniniwala sa espiritu ng isda, mabuting ehersisyo iyon para sa isip. Kailangan nating malaman ang epekto natin sa kapaligiran.

records.source: You can find rainbow trout in streams right now.
records.translation: Makakahanap ka ngayon ng Trutsang Bahaghari sa mga sapa.

records.source: This is an easier time of year for me. I don't have to worry about staying warm.#$e#Plus, the fruits of the wild are growing everywhere.
records.translation: Mas madaling panahon ito ng taon para sa akin. Hindi ko kailangang mag-alalang manatiling mainit.#$e#At tumutubo sa lahat ng dako ang mga bunga ng ilang.

records.source: I've explored deep into the caves.#$e#They hold some hidden secrets.#$e#Just be cautious if you go in there.
records.translation: Ginalugad ko ang malalalim na bahagi ng mga yungib.#$e#May mga nakatagong lihim doon.#$e#Mag-ingat ka lang kung papasok ka.

records.source: #$1 LinusFall1#Some joker sprayed paint all over my home during the night... It took hours to scrub it off this morning.$k#$e#I need to start gathering lumber for the winter.#$e#Do you have enough lumber to keep your house warm?
records.translation: #$1 LinusFall1#May hangal na nagwisik ng pintura sa buong tahanan ko kagabi... Ilang oras kong kinuskos iyon kaninang umaga.$k#$e#Kailangan kong magsimulang mangalap ng kahoy para sa taglamig.#$e#May sapat ka bang kahoy upang panatilihing mainit ang bahay mo?

records.source: I don't have many responsibilities, so I spend my time thinking.#$e#You have to understand your thoughts before you can control them.
records.translation: Wala akong maraming pananagutan, kaya ginugugol ko ang oras sa pag-iisip.#$e#Kailangan mong maunawaan ang mga iniisip mo bago mo makontrol ang mga iyon.

records.source: I don't like to stay in one place for too long.
records.translation: Ayaw kong manatili nang napakatagal sa iisang lugar.

records.source: There's nothing quite like a feast of wild mushrooms in the fall.$h
records.translation: Walang katulad ang piging ng mga ligaw na kabute sa taglagas.$h

records.source: It can get really cold if you live in a tent.$s
records.translation: Talagang napakalamig kapag nakatira ka sa tolda.$s

records.source: After you've truly unplugged from the modern way of life, you'll start to really enjoy the simple things... like the sun, a ripe fruit, or finding a stick with the exact shape you were looking for.
records.translation: Kapag tunay mong iniwan ang makabagong paraan ng pamumuhay, sisimulan mong talagang tamasahin ang mga simpleng bagay... gaya ng araw, hinog na prutas, o paghahanap ng patpat na may eksaktong hugis na hinahanap mo.

records.source: Thanks for not shunning me, @. It takes a lot of wisdom to override your base instincts.#$e#I'm a human like everyone else. I just have a different lifestyle.
records.translation: Salamat sa hindi paglayo sa akin, @. Kailangan ng malaking karunungan upang manaig sa mga likas na bugso ng damdamin.#$e#Tao rin ako tulad ng lahat. Iba lang ang pamumuhay ko.

records.source: I'm sure you understand why I'm cautious of strangers.#$e#But let's put that in the past, okay? You and I are friends now, I think.
records.translation: Tiyak na nauunawaan mo kung bakit maingat ako sa mga estranghero.#$e#Pero iwan na natin iyon sa nakaraan, sige? Magkaibigan na tayo ngayon, sa tingin ko.

records.source: Winter is tough, but you can still fish and forage to get by.#$e#If you have any animals you should keep them inside.
records.translation: Mahirap ang taglamig, pero maaari ka pa ring mangisda at mangalap upang mabuhay.#$e#Kung may mga hayop ka, dapat mong panatilihin ang mga iyon sa loob.

records.source: The trees go to sleep during the winter. It makes it a bit lonely out here.#$e#But I wouldn't deny them their beauty sleep.$h
records.translation: Natutulog ang mga puno tuwing taglamig. Medyo nakalulungkot tuloy dito.#$e#Pero hindi ko ipagkakait sa kanila ang mahimbing na tulog.$h

records.source: Thanks for stopping by. I was actually feeling a little lonely this morning.#$e#So, have you discovered anything interesting in the mines?
records.translation: Salamat sa pagdaan. Medyo malungkot talaga ako kaninang umaga.#$e#Kaya, may natuklasan ka bang kawili-wili sa mga Minahan?

records.source: Sleeping on the ground is good for my back.#$e#It's best to look at the positive side of things.$h
records.translation: Mabuti sa likod ko ang pagtulog sa lupa.#$e#Pinakamabuting tingnan ang positibong panig ng mga bagay.$h
